citation: Speckesser, S., Runge, J., Foliano, F., Bursnall, M., Hudson, N., Rolfe, H., & Anders, J. (2018). Embedding Formative Assessment: Evaluation report and executive summary. London: Education Endowment Foundation.
report_number: EEF Embedding Formative Assessment (EFA), Round 7 effectiveness trial
design: Cluster-RCT (two-armed effectiveness trial); assignment level = School; 140 schools (70 intervention, 70 control); school blocking in 9 strata; outcome = GCSE attainment (Attainment 8 capped point score, plus English and Maths GCSE); pupils in Year 10/11 (ages 14-16, KS4; maps to grades ~9-11); n=25,393 pupils in primary analysis.
problems: Primary outcome (Attainment 8) is a general/composite GCSE point score, not a single subject; mapped to 'Other'. Secondary outcomes (English -> Reading, Maths -> STEM) report only Hedges' g and Ns (Table 7), with no group means/SDs, so g for those rows is taken directly from the report. Per-arm n for English/Maths is total pupils only; intervention/control split not given separately for secondary outcomes. ICC reported (Appendix H) is the design-effect ICC for the precise model; all g values are already model-based, cluster-adjusted, and KS2-pretest-adjusted.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Embedding Formative Assessment (EFA) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: GCSE Attainment 8 (capped GCSE point score, KS4_ATT8)
effect_sizes.g_method: Hedges' g reported directly by EEF (Table 5, precise model): model treatment coefficient divided by pooled SD = sqrt(residual var + between-school var), i.e. d=beta/s with total SD=0.880. g_se and g_var derived from the reported 95% CI (-0.01, 0.21): se=(0.21-(-0.01))/(2*1.96).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.5 Table 1; p.21 Table 5; p.62 Appendix H (ICC=0.09, total SD=0.880)
effect_sizes.notes: Primary outcome. Precise (ANCOVA-style multilevel) model adjusting for KS2 pretest plus stratification dummies, with school random effects (Stata mixed, REML). p=0.088 (sig at 10%). Impact_estimate is the raw mean difference (47.70-45.66=2.04 GCSE points); the model-based standardized impact is the reported g=0.10. Mean CIs: intervention 47.70 (45.32-50.07), control 45.66 (43.81-47.50). Subgroup/sensitivity g all positive (FSM 0.07; non-TEEP 0.13; simplest model 0.11).

effect_sizes.notes: Secondary outcome (English GCSE). N=22,628 total pupils; intervention/control split not reported separately. p=0.72, not significant. Means/SDs not reported for secondary outcomes.
